Messages.Author: Andre Wichmann
Messages.Body:
Here in Bonn (Germany), rumours claim that WotC have certain license or
financial problems and so no more JYHAD-Cards will be printed/delivered for
at least 6 months. Is that true??? (Hopefully NOT!)
 
                                       Andre Wichmann

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Andre Wichmann <wichmann@zeus.informatik.uni-bonn.de> wrote:
>Here in Bonn (Germany), rumours claim that WotC have certain license or
>financial problems and so no more JYHAD-Cards will be printed/delivered for
>at least 6 months. Is that true??? (Hopefully NOT!)

Well, it wasn't clear that the Jyhad license would be extended to allow
us to print more than 180 million cards, or to make any expansion sets,
but it has been.  However, those 180 million will finish printing this
month or next, and no release date of a further printing has been announced.
Keep in mind that we do have to also print the Gathering and Magic expansions,
and Carte Mundi does have other customers...

Messages.Author: Brian Wilson
Messages.Body:
Before I could do anything to stop it, Tom Wylie wrote:

> Well, it wasn't clear that the Jyhad license would be extended to allow
> us to print more than 180 million cards, or to make any expansion sets,
> but it has been. 

Help me to understand the way this is worded. Are you saying that, 
initially, nobody knew if the Jyhad license would be extended to allow 
the printing of more than 180 million cards, or to make any expansion 
sets, but that, since that time, the license *has* been extended, and the 
we *should* expect to see more cards *and* expansion sets?

I hope that's what you meant to say. I'm dying to see some Jyhad 
expansions. Oh, and don't forget to drop a few of the initial cards from 
the next printing. I need some ultra-rare, out-of-print cards for my 
collection <g>.
